verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਹੀਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit_en: dheepak pata(n)g dhib dhirasaT dharas heen sree gur dharas dhiaan tirabhavan ga(n)mitaa ||

en.bdb: What light of vision could he have found in an oil beacon, the moth becomes devoid of even seeing it since it dies on its flame. But the contemplation of True Guru's sight illuminates the vision of the slave of Guru that he is able to see all the happenings of the three worlds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਨਾ ਕਮਲ ਅਲਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਰਾਖਿ ਸਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਰੰਮਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit_en: baasanaa kamal al bhramat na raakh sakai charan saran gur anat na ra(n)mitaa ||

en.bdb: A black bee is fascinated by the smell of a lotus flower. However a lotus flower cannot stop him from visiting other flowers. But a devoted Sikh coming into the refuge of True Guru does not go anywhere else.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਹੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸੰਮਿਤਾ ॥
verses.translit_en: meen jal prem nem a(n)t na sahaiee hot gur sikh saagar hai it ut sa(n)mitaa ||

en.bdb: A fish sees through her love for water till the end. But when hooked to a bait, the water does not help her and can't save her. However a Sikh who is ever swimming in the safe ocean of True Guru is always helped by Him here and in the world beyond.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਸੈ ਟਰਤ ਨ ਮਰਤ ਸਬੈ ਸੀ੍ਰ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਬੰਗੀ ਸੰਗੀ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ॥੩੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: ek ek Tek sai Tarat na marat sabai seer gur saraba(n)gee sa(n)gee mahaatam a(n)mritaa ||319||

en.bdb: The fish never gives up it's one-sided love and infatuation. They die living in the love of their beloved. But the love of the True Guru frees one from the cycle reincarnation. Why should anyone turn their face away from such love of their Guru?
